one_paragraph_summary: Delivered June 21, 2023 at the Grand Ballroom of Shangri-La at the Fort for ACCRALAW's 50th Anniversary Gala, this keynote message by CJP opens with the Spanish salutation 'Compañeros y Compañeras, Damas y Caballeros' and thanks Managing Partner Trina Prodigalidad for the invitation. He recalls his 2012 ACCRA 40th anniversary speech on 'How the Judiciary Can Help the Economy' (covering Tanada v. Angara, La Bugal B'laan v. Ramos, and Gamboa v. Teves). He aligns ACCRA's 'Beyond Legal Excellence' CSR theme with FLP's philosophy -- citing Confucius ('teach a man to fish') as the governing principle -- and invites ACCRA to partner with FLP on the Museum for Liberty and Prosperity and the Prosperity Fund. He confesses his deepest professional regret: not joining ACCRA at its inception (he had too many prior commitments -- all of which became ACCRA clients anyway). When Trina joked 'Maybe it's best you didn't join ACCRA, otherwise you'd never have become Chief Justice,' CJP retorted: 'Then I would have been the first ACCRA partner to become Chief Justice' -- and predicts Trina herself will be the first, as 'Her Honor, retired Chief Justice Patricia Ann T. Prodigalidad,' guest of honor at ACCRA's 2048 diamond anniversary. He pays tribute to the late Senator Edong Angara (SEJA) -- ACCRA founder, ALA co-founder, and former UP President who gifted him a miniature Oblation replica for securing Japanese fire truck donations -- and to Ave Cruz, the only surviving founding partner and CJP's golf and dancing companion ('our longest drive goes no farther than 150 yards'), bound by a mutual promise to reach 100 without loss of mental prowess. He notes that none of the founders ever intruded in his Court work, and that he has 'invariably recommended ACCRA' since retirement. He closes: 'Congratulations to ACCRA as it hits gold, more gold on its glorious 50th Anniversary.'
